title: Grateful Dead Live at Eaton's list reads: on 1969-02-15

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar ’69 show featuring a soaring Dark Star, epic Mountains of the Moon and a blistering Other One.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this February‑15 1969 performance, calling it one of the best‑played shows of the year. The recording is praised as crystal‑clear and well‑balanced (soundboard), with only occasional cuts that don’t detract from the magic of Dark Star, Morning Dew, Mountains of the Moon and a ferocious Other One.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) across seven detailed reviews; reviewers highlight both superb musical moments and an excellent soundboard recording, with only minor technical glitches.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix praised as one of the best‑recorded Mountains of the Moon performances; a few isolated cuts (e.g., Lovelight) noted but not disruptive.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions highlighted – Mountains of the Moon into Dark Star feels studio‑like; Dupree’s sets a mellow mood that builds into the epic Dark Star and later into space/feedback jams. Overall pacing described as laid‑back yet intensely soaring.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's tone praised throughout, especially on the intro to "Death Don't Hurt Me" and the soaring Dark Star; his playing likened to Mahavishnu Orchestra’s intensity.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey's drumming noted during Chant and the Alligator > Drumz segment, with praise for the rhythmic interplay throughout the set.
